answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit in a shared harbor registry before it can trade. The deposit is locked for a fixed period and linked to verifiable work history, so a single operator cannot cheaply spawn a nebula of fake identities: each new identity needs its own deposit and its own waiting period. Reputation then grows like a vine, branching only from completed, attested transactions, and misbehavior burns part of the stake. Creating thousands of Sybils therefore costs thousands of deposits plus time, while honest agents pay once and keep their stake.
